client/board/draw-calls.note: Draw calls per frame with 93 instances of one shared asset.

client/board/frames-while-hidden.note: Frames drawn over 3s while the page reports itself hidden.

client/board/geometries.note: Resident geometries with 93 instances of a single prop asset.

client/board/nodes.note: Scene-graph nodes for the current room.

client/board/programs.note: Compiled shader programs; one program per material variant, not per entity.

client/board/shadow-auto-update.note: 1 means Three.js re-renders the shadow depth buffer every frame.

client/board/shadow-map-size.note: Shadow map resolution. Above 2048 the depth pass dominates the frame.

client/board/textures.note: Resident textures with 93 instances of a single prop asset. Prop model textures are shared per asset; a per-prop effect layer still contributes one each.

client/state/bubble-ms.note: Applying one speech bubble across a room's occupants and npcs.

client/state/chat-event-ms.note: Reducing one chat message in a 120-prop, 20-occupant room.

client/state/toggle-ms/32-occupants.note: Two UI toggles in a 32-occupant room.

client/state/toggle-ms/4-occupants.note: Two UI toggles in a 4-occupant room.

client/state/uuids-per-snapshot.note: crypto.randomUUID calls while re-normalising an unchanged 50-line chat history. Each one is a fresh identity for a line that did not change, which defeats downstream memoisation.

server/accounts/sticker-scans.note: Directory walks for 200 repeated sticker listings. The asset set is static for the lifetime of a runtime.

server/commands/sticker-dir-scans.note: Directory walks while building 50 command contexts.

server/connections/sender-tasks/after-60.note: Live asyncio tasks after 60 connect/disconnect cycles.

server/logging/dumps-when-disabled.note: Serialisations for 200 log records that were then discarded.

server/rate-limiter/keys/peak-under-40k-.note: Peak retained limiter keys while 40,000 distinct keys streamed through. Bounded by recent traffic rather than total traffic.

server/snapshot/bytes/room-max.note: Serialised snapshot size for a 20-occupant room. Encoded once per recipient, so this is multiplied by the occupant count on the wire.

server/snapshot/ms/room-max.note: Fastest observed snapshot in a 30-occupant room. The minimum is used because a busy test host inflates every other sample.

server/snapshot/occupants=40/entities.note: Entity count carried by the snapshot, for context.

server/snapshot/occupants=5/entities.note: Entity count carried by the snapshot, for context.

server/snapshot/queries/axis-cards-32.note: SQL statements for one snapshot at 32 cards. Room environment and authored action data are static per room, so this must not grow one statement per entity.

server/snapshot/queries/axis-peeps-32.note: SQL statements for one snapshot at 32 peeps. Room environment and authored action data are static per room, so this must not grow one statement per entity.

server/snapshot/queries/axis-props-64.note: SQL statements for one snapshot at 64 props. Room environment and authored action data are static per room, so this must not grow one statement per entity.

server/snapshot/queries/occupants=40.note: SQL statements for one snapshot in a room with 40 occupants.

server/snapshot/queries/occupants=5.note: SQL statements for one snapshot in a room with 5 occupants.

server/snapshot/queries/room-max.note: A fully populated room (40 occupants, 60 props, 12 peeps, 20 cards) must build a snapshot in a bounded number of statements. Per-occupant profile reads push this past 200.

server/tick/aura-queries/10-ticks.note: SQL statements for 10 repeat probes across 25 occupants in a room with an aura already applied. All of them answered 'already applied'.

server/tick/queries/5-ticks-25-occupants.note: SQL statements for 5 ticks in a room with 25 occupants. A tick with no expiring effects and no scripted behaviour should not touch the database.

server/tick/scheduled-tasks.note: asyncio tasks created to tick a 40-room world. One task per room would be 40.
